moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.description: Named places with their categories (basic_category, taxonomy) for local search: businesses, landmarks and points of interest of a region. Not addresses, and not a record of any party or facility.
moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.licenseName: By source: CDLA Permissive 2.0 (Meta, Microsoft and others), Apache 2.0 (Foursquare), CC0 1.0 (AllThePlaces)
moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.attribution: Overture Maps Foundation (overturemaps.org): places from Meta, Microsoft, PinMeTo and others (CDLA Permissive 2.0), Foursquare (Apache 2.0; its NOTICE applies) and AllThePlaces (CC0 1.0)
moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.obligations: Search results name each place's source datasets and licenses, and the search names Overture Maps Foundation. Apache 2.0 asks that Foursquare's NOTICE go with any copy of its data given to others.

moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.description: Building footprints of a region, drawn as a map layer of vector tiles made on this server. Footprints do not establish legal property boundaries.
moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.licenseName: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap, Microsoft ML Buildings), with CC BY 4.0 sources (Esri Community Maps, Google Open Buildings)
moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation; Esri Community Maps contributors and Google Open Buildings (CC BY 4.0)
moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.obligations: The layer's archive is a Derivative Database of ODbL data. Drawing it on a map is a Produced Work, which shows the attribution. Giving the archive or its tiles to anyone outside this installation is a public use of the Derivative Database, which must then be offered under the ODbL (or with its source data and the means to make it). The layer is read only by the users a map offers it to; keep it so unless that is meant.

moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.description: Address points of a region (street, number, unit, postal code, locality) for the local address search: a geocoder of this server that asks no outside service. Alpha data of partial coverage: a region may have none or some of its addresses, many without a postal code, and a point may be an entrance, a building or parcel centre or a position on the road, which the data does not say. Not a postal-code directory.
moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.licenseName: By source, varying by country and dataset (open data licenses such as CC0 1.0 and CC BY 4.0, national public domain, and sources Overture marks proprietary): each is reviewed when a run first finds it
moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.attribution: Overture Maps Foundation (overturemaps.org): addresses from the sources each result names, under their own licenses
moqui.maps.OvertureTheme.obligations: Each address found names its source dataset and license. CC BY sources ask for their attribution where the data is shown or shared; read the terms of a source marked proprietary (LicenseRef-Proprietary) before acknowledging it. The index is used on this server; giving its rows to others is a distribution under each source's license.

moqui.server.ReadinessProvider.title: Overture data
